source: App Client Map research (restaurants), 24 Nov 2026. Prices = first year (setup + 12 months), estimates. See lead_agent/RESEARCH.md.

quadrant_rule.note: price = geometric middle of lo..hi, first year (setup + 12 months)

approach.sweet: Easy and pays well. Lead with the commission they pay today and one regular-customer feature (loyalty, one-tap reorder). Offer a 2-minute demo on the phone and ask for 10 minutes.
approach.volume: Easy but cheap. Sell the simplest version: a digital punch card or pre-orders, quick to set up, low monthly price. Get to yes or no in one call.
approach.bigfish: Hard but pays well. Credibility first: a short demo video or mockup in their brand, proof from a similar place, 2-3 touches. Reach the owner or partner. Ask what they use today (Tabit, POS) and fit around it.
approach.skip: Cheap and hard, or an app is the wrong product. Don't run unless the user picks it; for catering, pitch a website instead.

types.name: Pizzerias
types.why: Delivery-heavy, the same families order every week, and every Wolt order costs them about a third. The saving is easy to show.
types.look: Bold and fast: big 'order again' button, the pizza builder front and centre, the shop's own colours.
types.pitch: Your regulars order from your own app, and the commission stays with you.
types.pitch_he: הלקוחות הקבועים מזמינים ישר מהאפליקציה שלכם, והעמלה נשארת אצלכם.

types.name: Burger joints
types.why: Burgers are the most-ordered dish on Wolt in Israel. High delivery share, young tech-savvy customers.
types.look: Dark and appetising: close-up food photography, combo deals, loyalty progress on the home screen.
types.pitch: Every tenth burger on the house, and orders without the delivery-app cut.
types.pitch_he: כל המבורגר עשירי עלינו, והזמנות בלי העמלה של אפליקציות המשלוחים.

types.name: Sushi & Asian
types.why: Large order values (₪150+), delivery-heavy and frequent. Sushi and Thai are among Wolt's top and fastest-growing categories.
types.look: Clean and premium: lots of white space, sharp dish photos, a build-your-own-roll flow.
types.pitch: Big orders straight to you, with a club that brings customers back every week.
types.pitch_he: הזמנות גדולות ישר אליכם, ומועדון שמחזיר לקוחות כל שבוע.

types.name: Ready meals & Shabbat takeaway
types.why: The same families pre-order every Thursday and Friday. The menu changes weekly, so push notifications sell by themselves.
types.look: Warm and homely: the weekly menu as the first screen, pre-order cut-off time, family-size portions.
types.pitch: The Shabbat menu reaches every customer's phone on Wednesday, and orders come in by themselves.
types.pitch_he: תפריט השבת מגיע לטלפון של כל לקוח ביום רביעי, וההזמנות נכנסות לבד.

types.name: Salads, bowls & healthy
types.why: Office lunch orders repeat daily, and the customers are young and app-friendly. Group orders are a strong hook.
types.look: Fresh and light: greens and whites, nutrition info, 'my usual bowl' one tap away.
types.pitch: Daily office lunches ordered in one tap, with group orders for the whole team.
types.pitch_he: ארוחת הצהריים של המשרד בהקשה אחת, כולל הזמנה קבוצתית לכל הצוות.

types.name: Cafés & coffee shops
types.why: Customers come several times a week and already know punch cards. Small orders, so the budget is small.
types.look: Cosy and branded: a digital punch card on the home screen, order-ahead for the morning rush.
types.pitch: A digital punch card and ordering ahead, so the morning queue moves.
types.pitch_he: כרטיסיית קפה דיגיטלית והזמנה מראש, כדי שהתור של הבוקר יזוז.

types.name: Bakeries & patisseries
types.why: Friday and holiday pre-orders (challah, cakes) jam the phone. Owner-run, but small margins per item.
types.look: Warm and crafted: product photos, a pre-order calendar, pickup time slots.
types.pitch: Friday and holiday orders come in through the app, not on the phone.
types.pitch_he: ההזמנות לשישי ולחגים נכנסות דרך האפליקציה, לא בטלפון.

types.name: Ice cream & juice bars
types.why: Visit-based loyalty fits small, frequent purchases, but it's seasonal and the budget is small.
types.look: Playful and colourful: a stamp card, flavour of the week, family packs for pickup.
types.pitch: A stamp card that brings families back all summer.
types.pitch_he: כרטיסיית ניקובים שמחזירה משפחות כל הקיץ.

types.name: Delivery-only kitchens
types.why: All their sales go through Wolt, so the commission hurts most. But with no walk-in customers, getting app downloads is hard.
types.look: Brand-first: strong logo and colours, a short menu, 'order again' up front.
types.pitch: Move your regulars off Wolt with a club price only in your own app.
types.pitch_he: להעביר את הלקוחות הקבועים מוולט לאפליקציה שלכם, עם מחיר מועדון רק אצלכם.

types.name: Small local chains (2-5 branches)
types.why: The biggest budgets: one club across all branches. But partners or a marketing manager decide, and some already use Tabit.
types.look: Brand system: branch picker, one club across branches, consistent design per brand.
types.pitch: One app and one club for all your branches, without paying commission.
types.pitch_he: אפליקציה אחת ומועדון אחד לכל הסניפים, בלי לשלם עמלות.

types.name: Chef & full-service restaurants
types.why: Bookings already go through Ontopo or Tabit and delivery is a small share. The value is a VIP club and events, which is a harder sell.
types.look: Elegant and quiet: dark tones, seasonal menu, event invitations, VIP club perks.
types.pitch: A VIP club that fills quiet nights and sells out events.
types.pitch_he: מועדון VIP שממלא ערבים שקטים ומוכר את האירועים שלכם.

types.name: Bars & pubs
types.why: Happy hour and events are a fit for push notifications, but the owners work at night and rarely prioritise tech.
types.look: Night mode: dark, neon accents, tonight's event and happy hour first.
types.pitch: Tonight's event and happy hour on every regular's phone.
types.pitch_he: האירוע של הערב וההאפי האוור מגיעים לטלפון של כל לקוח קבוע.

types.name: Shawarma, falafel & street food
types.why: Shawarma is Wolt's fastest-growing dish, but orders are small, owners are old-school and a lot is walk-in.
types.look: Simple and fast: big photos, a short menu, 'order again' and pickup time.
types.pitch: Pickup orders ready when the customer arrives, with no line.
types.pitch_he: הזמנות לאיסוף שמוכנות כשהלקוח מגיע, בלי תור.

types.name: Event catering
types.why: Orders are rare and big, so customers won't keep an app. A website with a quote form fits them better.
types.look: If anything, a catalogue: menus per event type and a quote request.
types.pitch: Better pitched a website with a quote form than an app.
types.pitch_he: מתאים יותר לאתר עם טופס הצעת מחיר מאשר לאפליקציה.
